info.title: AriaFlow Web API
info.description: HTTP API for the AriaFlow download manager. Defaults to loopback-only binding (127.0.0.1:8787). All endpoints except health probes require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when a token is configured.

tasks.description: IDM-style batch import; same wire format as POST /api/v1/downloads. Takes precedence over `urls`.

put.summary: Set or clear a task's speed limit
put.description: Sets the per-task download cap in bytes/sec. `0` disables the cap explicitly; `null` clears the per-task override (the global `perTaskSpeedLimit` applies). The key must be present. If the task is actively transferring it cycles pause→resume so the new cap takes effect.

limitRateBytesPerSec.description: bytes/sec; 0 = unlimited; null = clear per-task override

200.description: Limit stored; `restarted` reports whether an in-flight transfer was cycled to apply it

get.description: Streams the recorded file with `Content-Disposition: attachment`. Supports a single `Range: bytes=…` request (206). Requires the task to be completed.

200.description: File bytes (or the single `Range`-requested slice). `Content-Disposition: attachment`. Send `Range: bytes=start-end` for a 206 partial response.

206.description: Partial content (single Range request). `Content-Range: bytes start-end/total`.

404.description: Unknown id or file missing on disk

409.description: Not completed / not a regular file

post.summary: Save a completed task's file to a directory on the daemon host
post.description: Server-side copy into `destDir`. `filename` must be a plain file name (no separators). Existing target files are refused with 409 unless `overwrite: true`.

404.description: Unknown id, source file missing, or destDir does not exist

409.description: Target exists and `overwrite` was not passed (or not completed)

delete.description: Deletes history records. Pass `ids` (comma-separated row ids) to delete specific entries; omit it to clear the entire history.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated `download_history` row ids, e.g. `1,2,3`. Missing/empty clears all.

get.description: Same streaming semantics as the task file endpoint, keyed by a `download_history` row id. Works even after the task row was deleted. Only completed history entries are served.

200.description: File bytes (or the single `Range`-requested slice). `Content-Disposition: attachment`. Send `Range: bytes=start-end` for a 206 partial response.

206.description: Partial content (single Range request). `Content-Range: bytes start-end/total`.

404.description: Unknown id or file missing on disk

409.description: Not completed / not a regular file

post.summary: Save a history record's file to a directory on the daemon host
post.description: History-scoped variant of the task save-as endpoint. Same copy semantics; keyed by `download_history` row id.

404.description: Unknown id, source file missing, or destDir does not exist

409.description: Target exists and `overwrite` was not passed (or not completed)

get.summary: Export the built-in task category rules (machine-readable JSON)
List a directory (backs the in-app folder picker)
get.description: Read-only listing of entry metadata; never returns file contents. Requires the same bearer token semantics as the rest of the API. An empty `path` lists the daemon user's home directory.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute directory path; empty/missing lists the home directory.

parameters.name: showHidden
parameters.description: Include entries whose names start with a dot.

404.description: Path not found or not readable

get.summary: List stored SSH certificates (metadata only — private key material is never returned)

post.summary: Store an SSH certificate for sftp:// / ssh:// certificate authentication

put.summary: Replace a proxy (set isDefault=true to make it the default)
Update an SSH certificate. privateKey blank/absent keeps the stored key; passphrase blank keeps the stored one

delete.summary: Delete an SSH certificate (tasks referencing it will fail on next run)

post.summary: Probe a URL (metadata only; nothing is downloaded)

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream of download lifecycle events

200.description: text/event-stream; event names: download_created, download_started, download_progress, download_paused, download_resumed, download_completed, download_failed, download_cancelled, download_removed, status_changed

userAgent.description: Per-task User-Agent override; omit to inherit the global setting

sshCertificateId.description: SSH certificate id (ssh_certificates table) for ssh:// / sftp:// certificate authentication

apiEnabled.description: Runtime switch: all /api/v1/* return 503 feature_disabled when false. Local pipe is not gated.

apiBind.description: ADDR:PORT the daemon listens on. Boot-time value: takes effect after the daemon restarts; the --api-bind flag/ARIAFLOW_API_BIND overrides it. Empty is rejected (400). Non-loopback without a --token exposes download control to the network.

mcpEnabled.description: Runtime switch: /mcp returns 503 feature_disabled when false.

webUiEnabled.description: Runtime switch: / (embedded web page) returns a 503 page when false.

userAgents.description: Managed User-Agent list offered in the advanced download dialog (input + pick). Seeded on first run with common desktop/browser agents and curl/Wget. Settings saved before this field existed also receive the seed; an explicit [] is kept (list cleared). Entries are trimmed and deduplicated on save; control characters and entries longer than 512 bytes are rejected.

webUiBind.description: ADDR:PORT for the standalone web listener (desktop web page + same-origin /api/v1), e.g. 0.0.0.0:9090. Empty = disabled. Boot-time setting (restart required); --web-bind overrides.

overviewShowPaused.description: Show paused tasks in the overview's in-progress section

overviewShowNewTasks.description: Show newly created (pending/queued/waiting/retrying) tasks in the overview's in-progress section

autoQuitDaemon.description: Desktop-app preference: when the AriaFlow desktop app quits, also shut down ariaflowd. Off by default (UI quits, daemon keeps running).

overviewHiddenCards.description: Stat cards hidden from the overview page; empty shows all cards. Unknown ids are ignored.

deleteFilesOnRemove.description: Default for the 'also delete downloaded files' checkbox shown in remove-task confirmation dialogs

privateKey.description: OpenSSH PEM private key. Required for create; blank/absent keeps the stored key on update. Never returned.

passphrase.description: Passphrase for an encrypted key. Absent = keep/no change; "" = clear (refused for encrypted keys); non-empty = set.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the public key

destDir.description: Absolute path of the destination directory on the daemon host.

filename.description: Target file name; Must not contain path separators. Defaults to the task/history file name.

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing file with the same name. Refused with 409 otherwise.
